title: npm client ignores peer-dependency conflicts
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that installs despite conflicting peer requirements. The tree that installs is one npm itself refused to accept, so an incompatible transitive copy can shadow the version the project tested.
remediation: Resolve the peer conflict in the dependency graph instead of suppressing the check.
limitation: It matches a client setting that installs despite conflicting peer requirements in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
